documentation.content: A hatvp-ingestion Cloud Run Job execution failed. Inspect the execution details and pipeline_failed logs before retrying.

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.project_id = "yahatvp-pipeline-eu" AND resource.labels.location = "europe-west1" AND resource.labels.job_name = "hatvp-ingestion" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = "failed"
